import re
s=open('sources/1805.05483.txt').read()
print('ENERGY RANGE 72300-74700'); print(s[72300:74700])

print('faithful at',locs)
a=min(locs)-1500; b=min(len(t),max(locs)+2500)

print(t[a:min(b,a+13000)])
